sn46.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn46.4:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
sn46.4:1.4: “āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
sn46.4:2.3: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgoti.
sn46.4:2.5: imesaṃ āvuso, sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ. tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharāmi.
sn46.4:2.6: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ viharituṃ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ viharāmi.
sn46.4:2.7: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi sāyanhasamayaṃ viharituṃ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena sāyanhasamayaṃ viharāmi.
sn46.4:2.8: satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me āvuso, hoti appamāṇoti me hoti. susamāraddhoti me hoti. tiṭṭhantaṃ tiṭṭhatīti pajānāmi.
sn46.4:2.9: sacepi me cavati, idappaccayā me cavatīti pajānāmi -pe-
sn46.4:2.10: upekhāsambojjhaṅgo iti ce me āvuso hoti. appamāṇoti me hoti. susamāraddhoti me hoti. tiṭṭhantaṃ tiṭṭhatīti pajānāmi.
sn46.4:2.11: sacepi me cavati, idappaccayā me cavatīti pajānāmi.
sn46.4:3.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro assa.
sn46.4:3.2: so yaññadeva dussayugaṃ ākaṅkheyya pubbanhasamayaṃ pārupituṃ. tantadeva dussayugaṃ pubbanhasamayaṃ pārupeyya.
sn46.4:3.3: yaññadeva dussayugaṃ ākaṅkheyya majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ pārupituṃ. tantadeva dussayugaṃ majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ pārupeyya.
sn46.4:3.4: yaññadeva dussayugaṃ ākaṅkheyya sāyanhasamayaṃ pārupituṃ tantadeva dussayugaṃ sāyanhasamayaṃ pārupeyya.
sn46.4:3.5: evameva kho’haṃ āvuso, imesaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbanhasamayaṃ viharituṃ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbanhasamayaṃ viharāmi.
